categories.label: Validation error
categories.description: Input is syntactically or semantically invalid (CNPJ malformed, required field empty, date out of format). Detectable BEFORE touching the database.

categories.label: Authentication error
categories.description: Not authenticated, token expired or session invalid.

categories.label: Authorization error
categories.description: Authenticated but lacking permission for the requested resource or action.

categories.label: Not found
categories.description: Resource doesn't exist (or is not visible to the current data-scope).

categories.label: Conflict
categories.description: State conflict — duplicate key, concurrency violation, version mismatch.

categories.label: Rate limit exceeded
categories.description: Exceeded the rate limit configured at the gateway.

categories.label: Upstream dependency failure
categories.description: Failure in a downstream dependency (Feign call, SEFAZ, Calculadora Oficial, external service).

categories.label: Internal server error
categories.description: Genuine server bug — unhandled exception path. Falls through to GlobalExceptionHandler's generic handler.

categories.label: Business rule violation
categories.description: Input is valid but violates a domain rule that depends on state (cliente já existe, estoque insuficiente, caixa já aberto). Detectable only after consulting the database or another service.

categories.label: Session stale
categories.description: JWT carries an outdated access-model version (modelo_acesso_versao). FE must refresh the access decision and retry.

extension_fields.name: code
extension_fields.description: Stable identifier for the error, namespace-prefixed by module (e.g. 'cad.cliente.duplicado'). Source for i18n keys and FE branching.

extension_fields.name: category
extension_fields.description: One of categories[*].id. Drives default FE behaviour.

extension_fields.name: correlationId
extension_fields.description: Request correlation id from MDC; pairs the error with backend logs.

extension_fields.name: timestamp
extension_fields.description: Server time when the error was emitted (with timezone).

extension_fields.name: fields
extension_fields.description: Field-level errors (used by 'validation' category). Each entry: {field, message, rejectedValue?}.

extension_fields.name: context
extension_fields.description: Free-form metadata for debug or FE display logic (e.g. clienteIdExistente, valorTomathe, codigoSefaz).

$comment: Workspace ships with empty modules (D-103, Gap B). See _examples/eerripe-error-model.partial.json for the BOSQ-ERP error codes. HTTP/RFC categories stay framework-level above.
